w: Swamishri blessed a small gathering of devotees at our farm while fresh jaggery was being made.
This morning Swamishri visited our farm in Gondal. After enquiring about the variety and quality of crops, Swamishri saw how fresh jaggery was being made.

Thereafter a small assembly was organised and Swamishri addressed the devotees, "...Sugarcane is cultivated here. Once it is ready it is crushed and its juice is boiled. Then the dirt and unwanted elements are separated and the concentrated juice is poured in another vessel where again any remaining dirt is sieved. The juice becomes pure and free of dirt and then it is ready to be made into jaggery. In a sugar factory we see that the sugarcane is thrown in from one side and we get pure, white sugar at the other end. Similarly, we have come into Satsang to become pure and rid ourselves of anger, lust, greed, jealousy and desires. Since we have the association of God and His holy sadhu we will definitely become pure. As long as these sugarcane sticks are here they will get processed, sooner or later, and become pure. Likewise we should withstand the extent of hardships and trials that come in life - be it in times of praise or insult. Because of mundane thoughts one falls back from Satsang. And to prevent this one should do Satsang.

May we become pure, to the extent that Maharaj wishes us to be, and offer devotion to Him. The holy shrine of Aksharderi fulfils the wishes of all. May we resolve today to become pure, brahmroop, and offer devotion to God."

At 10.45 a.m., Swamishri performed the murti pratishtha rituals in the assembly hall in Atladara mandir for the newly constructed mandirs in Ranoli and Chhani (Jakatnaka). Swamishri then addressed the devotees and blessed them.

In the afternoon, Swamishri departed from Atladara and arrived at the Swaminarayan Mandir in Bharuch at 6.50 p.m. After Thakorji's darshan and abhishek of Nilkanth Varni, Swamishri departed for Dummas.

At 5.30 p.m., Swamishri departed from Gandhinagar and arrived in Sarangpur at 7.50 p.m. The students of 'Pramukh Swami Vidya Mandir' played the band and welcomed Swamishri at the Yagnapurush Smruti Mandir. After Thakorji's darshan, Swamishri attended the welcoming assembly.

Today was Chaitri Padvo. On this day drinking neem juice is considered very beneficial. The sadhus had prepared neem juice in the rupchoki. They urged Viratswarup Swami, but seeing the bitter juice, he bowed and was about to get up. But Swamishri himself commanded him, "Drink one sip." At Swamishri's command he drank a sip, and immediately Swamishri said, "Now everyone sitting here, drink one sip each." He commanded everyone to drink the bitter juice.
Usually Swamishri leaves a memory by giving sweets, but sometimes, by giving bitter neem like this, Swamishri makes us drink the immortal nectar of memory.

Today a potter named Purushottambhai from Rojid had been invited to the pradakshina of the Smruti Mandir. He was turning the wheel and shaping a pot. Swamishri cast his glance on him. When Swamishri realised he had come from Rojid, he immediately told the sadhus, "Give him breakfast."

ds.t: Guidance for a father and son
w: In the morning Swamishri was going towards the Smruti Mandir. On the way, seeing a devotee, Swamishri himself told him, "Come at meeting time." When he came now, Swamishri asked him all the details about not being on speaking terms with his son, and gave him guidance.

A letter came from Chunibhai Chaturvedi, who on Brahmaswarup Yogiji Maharaj's command had done much seva in Gondal. As always, Swamishri wrote a lot in reply in his own hand. Swamishri is caring in every way for this godly devotee of modest means.
